description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/search/evidence (evidence $0.1; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?q=x402+payment+protocol (optional n=5-8, default 6). Search evidence pack: one web search, then the top 5-8 result pages are read and returned as short quoted passages (up to 3 per page, 300 characters each) with the source link, title, rank and the time each page was read. Extractive only: no AI-written text, no summaries. Pages that fail are listed with the reason. Not charged when the search has no results or no page can be read. USDC on Base only.
